verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into his E (Counter Strike) or get caught by his Q-W-E all-in before level 6; you win if you poke with Q (Snip Snip!), dash-and-reset with E (Skip 'n Slash), and let R (Needlework) close out trades from level 6 on.

brief.thesis: Jax's real threat is the Q (Leap Strike) into W (Empower) into E (Counter Strike) chain — Counter Strike only dodges basic attacks, so it punishes you specifically for auto-attacking him, not for landing Q. Gwen's W (Hallowed Mist) lets you decide when that chain is allowed to start, since he has to walk into the mist to touch you. The lane is close because his all-in burst peaks early while your true-damage poke and R healing scale harder once you hit six.

theirWindow.what: He can leap with Q, empower an auto with W, then dodge your next basic attacks and stun you with E for a full combo. Don't throw autos into this window — if you're forced to trade, stick to Q snips and back off, since Counter Strike can't touch those.

yourWindow.when: His E (Counter Strike) just went down
yourWindow.what: Dash in with E (Skip 'n Slash) and chain Q (Snip Snip!) snips freely, then disengage with W (Hallowed Mist) before Leap Strike (17-5s cooldown) comes back up. This is your highest-value trade window every time he uses the stun.

start.why: Run by 49% of players over 1010 games (83.3% pick) — the mana sustains your Q spam through his Leap Strike poke and the extra potion buys you room to hold the lane through his level 3-6 all-in window.

boots.why: Picked in 50% of games at 49.9% WR. Jax's damage is auto-attack-reliant — R (Relentless Assault) attack speed stacking, empowered autos from W — so flat auto-attack reduction directly blunts his all-in combo more than raw magic pen does this early.

core.why: First item in the strongest measured path (65.8% WR, 187 games) — gets your burst and sustain online before his power spike fades.
Second item in that same 65.8% WR line — adds the burn-adjacent magic burst that turns your Q/E poke into real trade damage.
Closes out the 65.8% WR / 28.4% pick path and scales your true-damage passive hardest into the late game.

the game is going long and you're sieging or extending fights rather than dueling

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks off repeated Q (Snip Snip!) and auto hits during extended trades, and the adaptive force/healing from stacks helps you outlast Jax's burst rather than racing his all-in.

summoners.why: Run in 57.7% of games at 50.7% WR. Since the matchup carries a solo-kill edge for Jax, Ignite gives you the burn to punish his Leap Strike overextensions and close out skirmishes before his Counter Strike cooldown resets.

playing.title: Never auto into his E
playing.detail: Counter Strike dodges all incoming basic attacks before stunning — right-clicking him while it's up just feeds the stun. Throw Q (Snip Snip!) instead since it's an ability, not a basic attack, and still lands clean.

playing.title: Pop Mist on his Leap Strike
playing.detail: W (Hallowed Mist) only lets enemies who enter it target you, so once Jax commits Q (Leap Strike) onto you, dropping Mist forces him to either walk in on your terms or waste the engage.

playing.title: Trade in the dash window
playing.detail: E (Skip 'n Slash) gives attack speed, range, and magic on-hit for a few seconds and partially refunds its own cooldown on a hit — use it right after he's used Leap Strike or Counter Strike, not before.

playing.title: Hold trades until level 6
playing.detail: R (Needlework) slows and applies A Thousand Cuts on hit, giving you sustain and reach he doesn't have an answer for. Play passive through levels 3-5 if he has summit spells and E up.

playing.title: Respect the solo-kill window
playing.detail: Data shows Jax holds the solo-kill edge in this matchup — don't contest all-ins at low HP between levels 3 and 6 even if you think you out-damage him on paper.

playing.title: Watch his Empower (W) cooldown
playing.detail: At 7-3s cooldown scaling, a fully empowered auto or Leap Strike hits hard — if you see it light up right before he approaches, back off a step rather than contest.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning — cooldown windows, the Counter Strike dodge rule, Mist engagement logic — is my own tactical read, not sourced data.
